A '''video sensor''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] that was extendible and fully maneuverable. They could be used to inspect small and enclosed spaces. They were capable of conducting telescopic and microscopic scans. [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] equipped their [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droids]] and [[Hound-W2 SPD]]s with video sensors.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> [[IN-4 information droid]]s were equipped with video sensors.
